summary: Division No. 18 tower listed at 30 m (100 ft); Maurice Bourassa listed there 1999-2001; no build date, status or current site description found.

events.note: Maurice Bourassa is listed at Junction from 1999 to 2001.

evidence.supports: Note in Bourassa entry: first observer in Junction Tower
Burns Matheson transferred to Hudson Bay (Junction) in 1945; not clear that this is the tower
evidence.quote: He transferred to Hudson Bay (Junction) in 1945

notes_for_editor: Firelookout.ca lists no elevation, height, year built or status for Junction. The 100 ft height comes from the websiteservice tower list. A note under the NISBET entry on the websiteservice tower list reads 'Circa 1916 Junction Ranger Tower Nisbet Forest'; it may refer to a different structure, so it was not used. The 1945 'Hudson Bay (Junction)' reference may be a station rather than this tower. No canada-lookouts.weebly.com page for Junction was found (404). Not checked: Saskatchewan DNR annual reports for Junction, and any current SPSA detection-tower list.
